title: Days of Jesus or days of the wicked
english: On what is written: [[The people served the Lord all the days of Jesus and all the days of the elders who had seen the Lord’s great works >> Bible:Judges 2:7]]. The lector read “feared”; we have “served.” Each of us makes for himself either Jesus’ days or the wicked’s days. If [[the true light that enlightens everyone >> Bible:John 1:9]] lights the soul and [[the sun of righteousness >> Bible:Malachi 4:2]] rises, we have Jesus’ days — days of salvation. If we take an extinguishable light, we have evil days of Manasseh or Pharaoh. In wicked Ahaz’s days Isaiah could not see the Lord until that bad king died.

title: Justice and peace in his days
english: Of the Lord’s days the prophet says: [[In his days justice will arise and abundance of peace >> Bible:Psalm 72:7]]. Not only of the Savior’s fleshly sojourn — then his crucifiers had no peace. Each person by conduct acquires days of justice or of iniquity. [[For those who fear my name the sun of righteousness will rise >> Bible:Malachi 4:2]]. [[Great peace have those who love your law >> Bible:Psalm 119:165]]. [[The light of the righteous endures; the light of the wicked is put out >> Bible:Proverbs 13:9]] — not another substance, but Christ the eternal light versus the devil’s false light when he [[transforms himself into an angel of light >> Bible:2 Corinthians 11:14]]. Pleasure, riches, worldly glory — days of a light that will go out; so too heretics’ [[falsely named knowledge >> Bible:1 Timothy 6:20]].

title: Long days of the elders
english: [[All the days of the elders who outlived Jesus and had seen all the Lord’s great works >> Bible:Judges 2:7]]. Long days are those stretched by knowing God’s works; the wicked’s days are short. Those who saw the Lord’s great works — experience confirms faith. After Jesus, the church’s elders who have seen the mysteries lengthen salvation’s days among the people.

title: They knew the Lord’s works
english: [[In the days of the elders who knew all the works the Lord did for Israel >> Bible:Judges 2:7]]. To know the works is not by rumor alone but by sight and share. In the church let us know Christ’s works in us — then we have Jesus’ days. Glory forever. Amen.
